arguments.message: Hi! To avoid an overage charge, first remove the departed employee from Settings → People. That frees the seat right away. Then invite the new hire into that same seat. As long as the removal and invitation happen within the same billing cycle, the seat count for billing will stay at one, not two. The invoice will reflect only one seat for that cycle.
